title: Mitcham Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to 24-hour A&E, urgent care, local hazards, and emergency supplies in Mitcham.
content:
For any life-threatening emergency, always call 999 immediately (or 112).

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT (Designated Major Trauma Centre).
Travel: From Mitcham Fair Green or Mitcham Eastfields station, it is approximately 2 miles north-west (a 35-40 min walk) via London Road and Tooting High Street, or take bus 264, 270, 280, or 355 directly to Tooting.
- St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton, SM5 1AA (24-hour A&E ~2 miles south-west; take bus 280 from Mitcham Fair Green).
- Croydon University Hospital, 530 London Road, Thornton Heath, CR7 7YE (take bus 264 eastbound).

2. Urgent Treatment Centre (UTC):
Wilson Health Centre UTC, Cranmer Road, Mitcham, CR4 4LD (approx. 5 min walk from Mitcham Fair Green for urgent treatment of minor wounds and illnesses).

3. Local Area Hazards:
- The River Wandle runs along the western edge (Phipps Bridge, Ravensbury Park), posing flood risks to parkland footpaths and adjacent roads.
- Low drainage areas surrounding Mitcham Common can become marshy and impassable on foot during prolonged rain.

4. Essential Supplies During Outages:
Supermarkets and pharmacies across London Road, Upper Green West, and Majestic Way can supply first aid items, prescriptions, and clean bottled water.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
